fusion_ranked_evidence.title: Delhi Opens First Women's Police Station, Marking New Step Towards Gender-Sensitive Policing
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: ## The new police station will exclusively handle cases involving women and children while providing specialised investigation, counselling and victim support. **New Delhi:**Delhi has inaugurated its first full-fledged women's police station, a pilot initiative aimed at providing a safer, more accessible and women-friendly environment for survivors of gender-based violence to report crimes and seek justice. Located in North Delhi, the new police station will exclusively handle cases involving women and children. The all-women police station is expected to improve access to justice through specialised investigation, counselling and victim support while encouraging more women to report offences without fear or hesitation. Delhi opened its first women's police station (ETV Bharat). Although Delhi already has Crime Against Women (CAW) Cells and Pink Booths, this is the first dedicated women's police station in the national capital. Delhi's first women's police station has been launched nearly five decades after the concept was introduced in the country. The team Delhi's first women's police station (ETV Bharat).
